an10.219:1.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā vyantibhāvaṃ vadāmi,
an10.219:1.2: tañ ca kho diṭṭh' eva dhamme upapajjaṃ vā apare vā pariyāye.
an10.219:1.3: Na tvevāhaṃ bhikkhave sañcetanikānaṃ kammānaṃ katānaṃ upacitānaṃ appaṭisaṃviditvā dukkhass' antakiriyaṃ vaḍāmi.
an10.219:2.1: Sa kho so bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an10.219:3.2: ‘pubbe kho me idaṃ cittaṃ parittaṃ ahosi abhāvitaṃ, etarahi pana me idaṃ cittaṃ appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ, yaṃ kho pana kiñci pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ, na taṃ tatrāvasissati, na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī' ti.
an10.219:4.2: ‘dahara-t-agge ce so ayaṃ kumāro mettācetovimuttiṃ bhāveyya, api nu kho pāpakammaṃ kareyyā' ti?
an10.219:5.1: ‘Akarontaṃ kho pana pāpakammaṃ api nu kho dukkhaṃ phuseyyā' ti?
an10.219:5.3: akarontaṃ hi bhante pāpakammaṃ kuto dukkhaṃ phusissatī ti? 2.
an10.219:6.1: Bhāvetabbā kho panāyaṃ bhikkhave mettācetovimutti itthiyā vā purisena vā.
an10.219:6.2: Itthiyā vā bhikkhave purisassa vā nāyaṃ kāyo ādāya gamanīyo,
an10.219:6.5: Yaṃ kho me idha kiñci pubbe iminā karajakāyena pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, sabban taṃ idha vedanīyam,
an10.219:6.7: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave mettācetovimutti anāgāmitāya saṃvattati, idha paññ' assa bhikkhuno uttariṃ vimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato ti. 3.
an10.219:7.3: upekhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.
